experiment: A6 three-arm comparison: keyword rule / base / prompted / adapted, on one frozen development slice
owner: Mingyu He (candidate contribution; not merged into the team branch)
model: llama-3.1-8b-instruct via Open WebUI on DGX Spark (POST /api/chat/completions)

slices.eval: data/a6_manifest.json 'eval' = the A4 81-case sample (27 per stratum; all 27 rule-error cases)
slices.tuning: data/a6_manifest.json 'tuning' = 12 cases from the remaining pool (4 B, 4 C intake-review Yes, 4 C No); prompt debugging only
slices.train_pool: everything else in the guarded scope; the only cases an adapter or few-shot example may use

arms.rule: 7-keyword fraud rule for routing; fraud word OR legal language OR 'fee' for review (narrative only)
arms.prompted: prompt prompted-v1 (baseline-v1 + team routing and review rules from TW5 section 6; zero-shot)
arms.adapted: prompt adapter-v1 (decision-only schema) on the model id that serves the team adapter; not run by this candidate

primary_reference: team route: an adjudicated label wherever one exists (disputed cases excluded and reported separately); otherwise the course routing_destination, which is only accepted on strata B and C. Adjudication files, in precedence order: (1) team two-labeller P3 file, team/tw5-data-pipeline e7eb32d, data/adjudication/p3_adjudicated_labels.csv (27 stratum-A cases); (2) the A6 discordant-case audit below.
review_reference_for_floor: review_ref_intake (urgency High/Critical OR escalation; the post-outcome consumer_disputed component removed)

decision_rule.R1_text: candidate routes more decided cases correctly (team reference) than the incumbent, exact two-sided McNemar p < R1_alpha
decision_rule.R2_text: candidate routes more decided cases correctly than the keyword rule arm (otherwise a deterministic rule is sufficient, TW2 commitment)
decision_rule.R3_text: review recall against the intake reference is at least the floor (missing a review is the costly error)
decision_rule.R4_text: at least this share of outputs parse as ok or repaired
decision_rule.R5_text: median latency is at most this multiple of the incumbent's
decision_rule.adopt_if: all of R1-R5 pass; otherwise the incumbent stays and the failed criteria are reported

frozen_on: 2026-10-13, after the 12-case tuning pilot (runs 20261013T115000Z prompted, 20261013T115255Z base) and before any evaluation-slice model run
notes: Development data only. The held-out file is never read (data_guard refuses it); this is not the formal evaluation.
prompted-v1 encodes rules the team wrote after reading the 27 stratum-A cases, so its stratum-A result is optimistic.
n = 79 decided cases: a McNemar test on this slice can only detect large differences.
verdict_reporting: V1 (pre-registered, reported unchanged): decision rule against the team reference with the P3 file only.

V2 (pre-registered): the same decision rule after a blind audit of every evaluation case without an adjudicated label on which any model arm's route differs from the course route. Cases on which every arm agrees with the course route cannot change a paired comparison, so only discordant cases are audited. The audit sheet hides course labels and arm outputs. A single-labeller audit is reported as provisional until a second team member labels the same cases.
tuning_pilot_findings: prompted-v1 ran 12/12 parsed ok; prompt tokens 602-1288 (model context 32,768 per /api/models).

Course routing labels on B and C are generated by the 7-keyword rule in both directions: e.g. tuning case 2323748 (a merchant charge 'in error', called 'fraudulent') is labelled Fraud & Security and 1686049 ('I did not authorize this charge', no keyword) is labelled Billing. Scoring B and C against the course label alone would reward imitation of the keyword rule. Response: V2 audit above (design change made on tuning evidence only).

prompted-v1 set human_review_required = true on 11/12 tuning cases, often citing 'a fee' or 'too little information'. Not tuned: the review references (course label, intake proxy, team rule) disagree with each other, so tuning to any one of them would be fitting a contested label. Reported as a finding about the team review rule (P4).
